# MyArchitectAI

> > AI-powered rendering software that transforms architectural and interior design models into photorealistic visualizations with integrated CAD support.

MyArchitectAI is a cloud-based rendering platform designed for architects, interior designers, and furniture designers. It integrates with major CAD tools like SketchUp, Revit, Archicad, and Rhino to provide fast, AI-powered design visualization with style transfer, editing, and enhancement capabilities.
